senses.zh: 扁魚，石珠仔魚，臺灣間爬岩鰍 (黏於石上
senses.en: ) fish sp., Hemimyzon formosanum (Boulenger) (a type of fresh water fish, which often sticks to a rock)

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.74，atas 條下派生詞

records.text: aubil a daali ka aunu nisiw

senses.en: This will be for you some other day.

records.text: aubil a dali, taruad a imini ka parisan adang a rakihan a mamaleng

senses.zh: 後來有一天，那時 Taruat 生了一個男孩
senses.en: Later on a certain day, Taruat had a baby boy.

records.text: aba ka maara aubil a tata

senses.en: Then he married a second wife.
Then he married a second wife.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.74，aubin 條下派生詞

records.text: aubin a dali ka nahada ma'isakep

senses.en: We will have time to be together some time later.

records.text: aubin a dali, taruada imini ka parisan adang a rakihan a mamaleng

senses.zh: 後來有一天，那時 Taruat 生了一個男孩
senses.en: Later on a certain day, Taruat had a baby boy.

records.text: babaw batu dini haka riak a babazu'an, auni siw

senses.zh: 這石頭上面可以洗衣服，讓妳洗
senses.en: It is good to wash clothes on the rock here.This place is for you.
It is for me to eat.

records.text: babaw batu dini haka riak a babazu'an, aunu nisiw!

senses.zh: 石頭上這兒好洗，給你吧！
senses.en: Above the rock here is convenient for washing. It is for you!
The clothes will be for me.

records.text: riaxi ka naki aunu tauxumak saarapun rakihan imini

senses.zh: 替我找個老婆照顧這個小孩吧
senses.en: Please find me a wife to take care of this baby.

records.text: arai adang a tauxumak aunu sarapun u rakihan

senses.en: Take another wife to take care of the baby later.
a piece of land for building a house
